HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 64-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.81, creatinine 0.72, hemoglobin 12.9, platelets 250, sodium 139, wbc 8.1; vitals dbp 75-80, heart_rate 68-73, map 94-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 130-135, spo2 96-97, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.72, hemoglobin 13, platelets 251, sodium 139, wbc 8.5; vitals dbp 75-78, heart_rate 69-73, map 95-98, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 132-137, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 64-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
